answer_1.quote: Building neural models that explain their predictions in natural language has seen increasing interest in recent years... Natural Language Explanations (NLEs) are generally easy to interpret by humans and more expressive than other types of explanations.

answer_2.quote: To automatically evaluate the quality of the NLEs, we follow and use the BERTScore, which was shown by to correlate best with human evaluation in NLEs.

answer_4.quote: An author and a third-party annotator performed independent annotations of the whole set of NLEs chosen to be evaluated... For the NLE quality assessment, each annotator is asked to answer the question: 'Does the explanation justify the answer?' and select one of four possible answers: yes, weak yes, weak no, or no.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators assess justification of explanations and identify shortcomings from predefined categories.
